header: Enable and disable logging for managed public zones
content:
gcloud
(#gcloud)
gcloud dns policies update
\
--networks=
\
--enable-logging
POLICY_NAME edit
NETWORK edit
gcloud
(#gcloud)
gcloud dns policies update
\
--networks=
\
--no-enable-logging
POLICY_NAME edit
NETWORK edit
gcloud
(#gcloud)
gcloud dns policies delete
\
POLICY_NAME edit
To turn on logging for an existing managed public zone, run the dns managed-zones update
(/sdk/gcloud/reference/dns/managed-zones/update) command.
Replace ZONE_NAME with the name of the DNS managed zone that you want to enable
logging for.
To turn off logging for an existing public managed zone, run the dns managed-zones update
(/sdk/gcloud/reference/dns/managed-zones/update) command.
Replace ZONE_NAME with the name of the DNS managed zone that you want to disable
logging for.
